shortDescription: Manage Self-IPs on a BIG-IP system

options.name: address
options.description: The IP addresses for the new self IP. This value is ignored upon update as addresses themselves cannot be changed after they are created. This value is required when creating new self IPs. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: allow_service
options.description: Configure port lockdown for the self IP. By default, the self IP has a "default deny" policy. This can be changed to allow TCP and UDP ports, as well as specific protocols. This list should contain C(protocol):C(port) values.

options.name: fw_enforced_policy
options.description: Specifies an AFM policy to attach to Self IP.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the self IP to create. If this parameter is not specified, it defaults to the value supplied in the C(address) parameter.

options.name: netmask
options.description: The netmask for the self IP. When creating a new self IP, this value is required.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on. You can set different partitions for self IPs, but the address used may not match any other address used by a self IP. Thus, self IPs are not isolated by partitions as other resources on a BIG-IP are.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: route_domain
options.description: The route domain id of the system. When creating a new self IP, if this value is not specified, the default value is C(0). This value cannot be changed after it is set.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), guarantees the self IP exists with the provided attributes. When C(absent), removes the self IP from the system.

options.name: traffic_group
options.description: The traffic group for the self IP addresses in an active-active, redundant load balancer configuration. When creating a new self IP, if this value is not specified, the default is C(/Common/traffic-group-local-only).

options.name: vlan
options.description: The VLAN for the new self IPs. When creating a new self IP, this value is required.
